:::{#sol-bernoulli-score-contribution-deviation}

Starting from @sol-bernoulli-score-contribution:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score_\iobs(\prob)
&= \frac{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}
&& \text{(score contribution)}\\
&= \frac{\outvar_\iobs - \prob}{\Var{\Outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{($\Var{\Outvar_\iobs} = \prob(1 - \prob)$)}\\
&= \frac{\outvar_\iobs - \E{\Outvar_\iobs}}{\Var{\Outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{($\E{\Outvar_\iobs} = \prob$)}\\
&= \frac{\devn_\iobs}{\Var{\Outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{(definition of $\devn_\iobs$)}\\
&= \precision \devn_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
